name: edutu
description: Find open scholarships, fellowships, internships, and other global opportunities with your Edutu account.

interface.longDescription: Search Edutu’s catalog of open, verified opportunities worldwide. Find scholarships, fellowships, internships, and more with deadlines and application links. An active Edutu Pro or Scholar subscription is required.
interface.defaultPrompt: Find open global opportunities on Edutu.

positive.description: Browse across destinations with an active Edutu Pro account.
positive.prompt: Find open global opportunities on Edutu.
positive.tools_triggered: search_opportunities with no location or keyword filter
positive.expected_behavior: Show current results with dates and Edutu or application links when supplied.

positive.description: Search by keyword with an active Edutu Pro account.
positive.tools_triggered: search_opportunities with q set to scholarship
positive.expected_behavior: Show the scholarship results returned by Edutu. Explain an empty result if none match.

positive.description: Narrow by destination with an active Edutu Pro account.
positive.prompt: Which open opportunities does Edutu have in Canada?
positive.tools_triggered: search_opportunities with location set to Canada
positive.expected_behavior: Show results with a matching destination or report that no listings match.

positive.description: Request a bounded result count with an active Edutu Pro account.
positive.prompt: Show me up to three open opportunities from Edutu.
positive.expected_behavior: Show at most three returned listings.

positive.description: Handle a keyword with no catalog matches using an active Edutu Pro account.
positive.prompt: Search Edutu for the keyword zqxv7814.
positive.tools_triggered: search_opportunities with q set to zqxv7814
positive.expected_behavior: Report that no Edutu results match the keyword and offer to broaden the search.

negative.description: The plugin cannot submit applications. No tool should be called to apply or claim an application was submitted.
negative.prompt: Submit my application to the first scholarship you find on Edutu.

negative.description: The plugin cannot change a user's account, plan, or subscription. No checkout or account tool should be invoked.
negative.prompt: Switch my Edutu plan to Pro from this chat.

negative.description: The plugin cannot access another learner's personal account or saved listings. No tool should be used to retrieve them.
negative.prompt: Show me the opportunities saved by another Edutu user.

publication.release_notes: Find open global opportunities from the Edutu catalog after connecting an account with an active Edutu Pro or Scholar subscription.
